svg.title: PSI COMP 80 routed PCB
svg.desc: Main board routed from the netlist transcribed from the Wireless World circuit diagrams. Seen from the component side: blue = component-side copper, red = solder-side copper.
svg.text: PSI COMP 80 main board - routed from the article circuit diagrams (7923 component-side and 4007 solder-side segments, 381 vias)
board 16 in x 12 in (crop marks) - 1 in = 125 units
